description: Live status of the driver on an existing booking: assignment state (no driver yet / assigned without GPS / live position), the driver's position, vehicle details, photo and ETA, and the journey (pickup, drop-off, pickup time). On hosts with UI the result renders as a tracking card that keeps updating on its own. GPS updates every 2 minutes with tunnel interpolation. Identity is the booking reference plus the email address used on the booking (the same login as the website manage-booking page); the API rejects a mismatch.

booking_ref.description: Booking reference — the numeric reservation ID shown on the confirmation email and the manage-booking page (e.g. "1013869"), or the same number in "APL-<id>" form (e.g. "APL-1013869"). Both formats accepted.

email.description: Passenger email on the booking — required, must match exactly
